message:
docs: record the 0.2.127 release

Docs only. No product, test, or build file is touched, and the artifacts that were signed
and published are the ones built from 9390211 -- unchanged by this commit.

0.2.127 went out signed, published and externally checked, and none of the three docs said
so. The release log stopped at 0.2.126, and 0.2.127 appeared nowhere in the tracked tree.

REL-V01 splits rather than closes. The published Stream now carries its own version and
the build came from a new directory, so the label half is done. The standing gate is not:
what ran this time was a one-off scan of the bytes, not a check that stays in the build,
and the runtime version was never observed.

That last part is the gap worth reading twice. No binary was executed on either side --
the user's GNLink holds UDP 43000 and neither of us wanted to race it for the port. So the
evidence is that the string 0.2.127 is in the shipped bytes and no stale one is, which is
not the same as the product displaying it. The field [connection-version] log after
install is what settles it, and all three docs now say so.
